items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: I know his name. Yes. He was confined to the hospital in Baton Rouge and he passed about two or three years ago.

ctx.x: I know you want to see this. Now we'll try to recall some of these names. I'll help you.

This is Ferdinand Davis. I'm sure you don't know him. I know his name. Yes. He was confined to the hospital in Baton Rouge and he passed about two or three years ago. This is Arthur Durbany. He's still living. Great alto player. Wonderful. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. This is- Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Oh yeah? All fine trumpet. Yeah. But he played sax with you. Sax with my band. And double on the trumpet. This is the greatest drummer that I've ever heard in my life, Albert Martin. And that's…
